9. Migrated UI controls retain semantic refusals and useful locations; rustc-dependent cases remain.
10. One feature-gated guest/response harness replaces copied helpers.
11. Runtime/live dispatch uses `protocol::Method`.

13. Activity uses shared typed replay and `Divergence`.
14. Proto scripts and wasm environment assignments are consolidated; callers/docs are updated.
15. Six guests inherit workspace lints while existing unsafe prohibitions remain.
16. The stock fixture belongs to its guest; runtime exports no test fixture.
17. The Model gate, reviewed goldens, and current guest/readers validate the integrated implementation.
